rubric.formula: 2*impact + evidence_deficit + architectural_leverage + validation_tractability + symptom_relevance + primary_need - 2*duplication_penalty - blocker_penalty

candidates.mechanism: Compare last physically fast opening path against Gen4 Alpha1 to isolate latency-regressing mechanism.
candidates.signal: Near-instant inner activation existed in an older field version; current shell wake is ~166 ms.
candidates.evidence: Current field timing + repository historical early-wake workflows/readmes.
candidates.prior_work_status: Historical artifacts exist; beta campaign has not yet revalidated exact last-good commit/mechanism.
candidates.representation_in_main: Legacy/history retained; current Gen4 uses blocking Binder call to wakeInnerDisplay on Dispatchers.IO.

candidates.target: Opening edge to physical wake critical path
candidates.mechanism: Decompose 166 ms shell latency into Duo-controlled and platform-controlled stages.
candidates.evidence: Field telemetry exists; earlier wake-generation research exists.
candidates.representation_in_main: timing exists but shell internal phases are not separated

candidates.mechanism: Classify failure class and trace exact fallback to wallpaper.
candidates.signal: Repeated field crashes and wallpaper fallback.
candidates.evidence: Field symptom strong; exact failure class unproven.
candidates.prior_work_status: older process recovery work exists but new stress failure not classified

candidates.mechanism: Reconstruct black cover incident and terminal ownership.
candidates.signal: closed cover black until extra open-close cycle.
candidates.prior_work_status: active slot07 now owns adjacent late-reassert ordering causal lead

candidates.mechanism: Turn field trigger into deterministic beta gate.
candidates.prior_work_status: campaign directive specifies required repro but no current beta gate yet

candidates.mechanism: Fail intended field APK builds when upload endpoint is absent.
candidates.signal: Send diagnostic data greyed out because URL empty.

selected_target: Identify the exact last-good fast-opening build/commit and the minimal opening-only mechanism lost or delayed in Gen4 Alpha1, without touching the now-smooth close path.

rejection_reasons.2: Overlaps prior wake-lifetime/critical-path research; regression archaeology can first identify the concrete mechanism to measure.
rejection_reasons.5: Important, but a separate independent lane and more dependent on fresh device crash evidence.
rejection_reasons.6: Adjacent causal lead is actively owned by slot07 and would duplicate live work.
rejection_reasons.9: Validation lane should consume a root-cause fix rather than replace regression isolation.
rejection_reasons.8: Root cause is already confirmed and narrower than the opening regression.

cheapest_decisive_first_action: Diff historical 1.3.24/1.3.29 early-wake implementation and commits against Gen4 Alpha1, then map the exact command path and timing semantics.
